selection.ordering: ascending visit_id then video_id from the official one-video CSV
selection.stop_rule: Stop immediately after the first eligible scene.

frozen_algorithm.representation: parent-normalized PCA lattice with nearest-boundary absolute-slot anchoring

forbidden_after_source_access: change ordinal parsing, lattice, boundary, pitch, or hidden-slot thresholds
read description annot_id values or target membership
run SC31 or ordinal selector outcomes during admission
admit left, right, top, or bottom directional ordinals without an authorized view orientation
reorder candidates or skip an eligible scene
claim_boundary: Outcome-blind provider-public source admission for boundary-anchored absolute ordinal grounding. Admission uses public task text, privileged functional labels, proposal geometry, and parent OBBs but no target membership or selector outcomes. Passing is not algorithm success, RGB proposal performance, live orientation, reachability, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety evidence.
